## Terms

Last updated: {{UPDATED}}

### 1. What it is
{{TOOL_NAME}} is a marketing management tool that {{OWNER}} hosts and uses themselves, to manage {{BRAND}}'s own Facebook Page, Instagram, Threads, YouTube and TikTok accounts. It is not a public service, is not open for sign-up, and is not provided to third parties.

### 2. Platform terms
By using this tool you agree to be bound by the [YouTube Terms of Service](https://www.youtube.com/t/terms); when using other platform features, you must also follow the respective terms of service and community guidelines of Meta, Threads and TikTok.

### 3. Publishing
The tool publishes content only after the account owner agrees on the confirmation screen. Videos sent to TikTok arrive in the account owner's TikTok as drafts (an inbox notification), where the account owner edits and posts them in the TikTok app; the tool never publishes publicly by itself.

### 4. User responsibility
The account owner is responsible for the content they publish, including music, commercial content disclosure and copyright.

### 5. Data
How data is obtained, used, kept and deleted is described in the Privacy Policy ({{PRIVACY_URL}}).

### 6. Disclaimer
This tool is provided as is, with no guarantee that it will be uninterrupted or error-free, nor that each platform's API will keep offering the same features.

### 7. Changes and contact
When these terms change, the date on this page will be updated. For questions, email {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}.
